description: Gujarat Police awarded ₹18 lakh to first-phase winners of the Sentinel Hackathon 2026 in Ahmedabad. The total prize pool for both phases is ₹51 lakh.
body_lead: The valedictory ceremony of the Gujarat Police Innovation Challenge 2026, also known as the Sentinel Hackathon 2026, concluded at i-Hub in Ahmedabad on October 13. The two-day event marked an important step in integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) with CCTV infrastructure to enhance public safety. Described as India’s largest AI-CCTV hackathon, the competition attracted participation from innovators, startups, and researchers across the country. Deputy Chief Minister Harsh Sanghavi, who presided over the ceremony, stated the initiative focuses on a human-centric approach to policing.
